observations: The exact four-message conversation completed without clarification. The agent read both workbook sheets, retained the 2022-2023 filter, defaulted the durable page to postnatal coverage with Gaya/Nalanda selected, and displayed the correct +5.0/+3.0 percentage-point changes and 7.0-point 2023 gap.
